milestone.title: raul TUI smoothness: frame gate, batch drain, dirty signal, sync output

intent.outcome: raul's TUI event loop is responsive under rapid input (held keys, scroll wheels) with no visible jitter or render storms, and individual frames don't tear when complex redraws happen (board view, detail view with markdown).

problem.description: The TUI event loop in crates/raul/src/tui/runner.rs:104+ is fully synchronous and re-renders on every crossterm::event::read(). Holding j or k to scroll produces a render storm — one full redraw per key repeat, no rate limit, no batching. There is no dirty-signal: even when state hasn't changed (e.g. key is a no-op for the current focus), a full redraw happens. There is no synchronized output (CSI ?2026) wrapping the draw, so complex views (board with 7 columns, detail with markdown) can show intermediate frames. See ~/ai-notes/projects/personal/master-plan/tui-redesign.md for the full herdr analysis. herdr's src/app/mod.rs applies all four of these techniques and the user reports its TUI feels noticeably smoother despite sharing the same ratatui 0.30 + crossterm 0.29 stack.

in_scope: Frame rate gate: cap renders at ~60fps (MIN_RENDER_INTERVAL = 16ms) so held-key storms can't outrun the display
Batched event processing: use crossterm::event::poll(Duration::ZERO) in a drain loop, process N pending events, render once
Dirty-signal flag: skip terminal.draw() when no state change occurred (set needs_render = true only on actual mutations)
Synchronized output guard: RAII struct wrapping CSI ?2026 h/l around every terminal.draw() call

Tests pinning the four behaviors: rate gate caps the redraw count under synthetic storms; batch drain coalesces N events into 1 render; dirty signal skips draws when state is unchanged; sync output sends the begin/end sequences
Manual verification: hold j/k in a 50-row list, confirm no visible jitter; switch lanes rapidly, confirm no tearing
out_of_scope: Async I/O (tokio, event channel) — see M138 below
Compute-then-render separation, ViewState, mode enum — separate milestone (M135, M136)
Scrollbars, keybinds, config TUI — separate milestones (M137, M139-M140)
Replacing crossterm::event::read() with custom byte framer (herdr's src/raw_input.rs pattern) — not justified for raul's needs
Animations or spinners — no animations exist in raul

findings.description: Code review (remediation applied): handle_esc on ContentState::List was writing app.tab_bar_focused = true directly without calling touch(). The dirty-signal contract was broken — pressing Esc on List while content was focused wouldn't trigger a redraw. Fix: capture prior focus flag, write true, bump version only on actual change (matches the AC-03 no-op-event rule). Same idempotent fix for the non-List branch. App::touch visibility changed from private to pub(crate) so runner.rs helpers can call it. Two new inline unit tests pin the contract.
findings.author: external-review-agent
findings.summary: M134 review: handle_esc dirty-signal violation fixed + 2 unit tests added

findings.description: When needs_render && !frame_clock.can_render(), run_loop skips the draw and blocks on wait_next(). A deferred frame is held until the next input event, not until the gate opens. After a burst ends mid-interval, the last mutation can remain unpainted until another key. Fix: before blocking, if needs_render, poll/sleep for remaining min_interval so deferred draw fires without waiting for input. Location: crates/raul/src/tui/runner.rs:352-415
findings.author: external-review-agent
findings.summary: Deferred frame blocked until next input

findings.description: SyncOutputGuard ignores write/flush errors (let _ =). A failed begin still drops an end sequence; silent I/O failure. Propagate or log write failures; at least fail begin loudly in debug. Location: crates/raul/src/tui/runner.rs:217-241
